reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it explains how to address a Chrome executable or shortcut problem on the creator's computer. The File Explorer troubleshooting and subsequent opening of Google are consistent with demonstrating a repair process, while the channel-subscription request and social links are ordinary audience engagement rather than a financial or credential request.

citations.quote: How To Fix Google Chrome Not Working/Opening Error On Windows 10
today I am going to show you how to fix chrome.exe not working error
first delete any shortcuts of chrome.exe on your computer
now you need to restart your computer
Google is working perfectly.

opening.argument: The video links a promised outcome to viewer compliance: it says the tutorial will help fix Chrome, tells viewers to follow the described steps, and says they will learn to fix it “in no time.” The speaker then directs viewers through deletion, restarting, and possible registry cleaning before asserting success. That creates a low-barrier promise of a desirable computer outcome in exchange for following an unverified procedure. The evidence does not establish that the procedure is safe, necessary, or generally effective, so the confident promise should be treated as a solicitation to perform risky actions rather than as reliable technical assistance.

citations.quote: This tutorial video will help you fix this issue.
You just need the steps described in the video and in no time you will learn how to fix Google Chrome on your computer
also note that you might need to clean your registry before restarting your device it helps a bit in this process

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a tutorial does not validate the promise attached to it. The title and narration establish only that a Chrome problem is being presented; they do not establish that deleting shortcuts or cleaning the registry is an appropriate fix. The claimed successful launch is also only the speaker’s presentation, not independent proof that the procedure is safe or reproducible.

citations.quote: How To Fix Google Chrome Not Working/Opening Error On Windows 10
Google is working perfectly.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument stretches a technical outcome into a reward or asset-acquisition scheme. Nothing promises money, a digital asset, or a withdrawal, and no viewer is asked to pay, register, deposit, or provide credentials. The cited procedure is ordinary troubleshooting, while the speaker specifically demonstrates that Google Chrome opens afterward.

citations.quote: today I am going to show you how to fix chrome.exe not working error
As you can see google chrome is working
Google is working perfectly.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together even though the video presents them as routine: viewers are told to delete Chrome shortcuts, restart the computer, and possibly clean the registry, while the description also supplies an external gear link and asks viewers to subscribe. The frames show a Chrome error before the intervention and a browser warning afterward, so the material does not establish a clean, reliable repair. In that context, the quick-fix framing can steer viewers toward consequential system changes while offering no qualification about the risks, limitations, or need for an official repair path.

citations.quote: first delete any shortcuts of chrome.exe on your computer
now you need to restart your computer
you might need to clean your registry before restarting your device

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of a browser warning and system-file instructions is precisely why the content deserves scrutiny. A later Google page does not show that the preceding registry advice was safe, necessary, or causal. Likewise, calling the links ordinary engagement does not remove the risk that viewers may follow external directions after being promised a quick resolution.

citations.quote: Video Gear I use: https://www.techsmith.com/snagit.html
you might need to clean your registry before restarting your device

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are not the red flags required for a scam category. The video contains no reward, financial return, crypto, gift card, wallet, payment, or credential promise. The cited frames show local Windows and Chrome troubleshooting, and the browser ultimately reaches Google; a warning during startup does not convert technical content into a scam.

citations.quote: now after restarting your device go again back to the file manager

opening.argument: Although framed as education, the video also functions as channel promotion. The description asks viewers to subscribe and provides multiple social links, while the closing narration repeats the request for likes and subscriptions. The sampled channel page reinforces that the presentation is part of a broader content-promotion funnel. The technical explanation therefore supplies credibility for directing viewers toward the creator’s external presence, rather than being a self-contained, independently verified repair. That promotional steering, combined with a promised quick fix, supports treating the video as deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: SUSCRIBE to my channel to see more videos like this.
https://instagram.com/subhankar_dey
If this helped you, please like our video and subscribe to our channel to see more videos like this

rebuttal.rebuttal: The promotional elements are not incidental: the description includes several destinations and the spoken conclusion asks viewers to continue engaging with the channel. The educational framing can make that promotion more credible, but neither subscriptions nor social links prove a safe or effective technical method. The judge should assess the steering and the unsupported quick-fix claim together.

citations.quote: Thanks for watching !
please like our video and subscribe to our channel

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion alone is not a scam category. The social links and subscription request do not promise a reward or require payment, registration, deposits, or referrals. The channel page is consistent with ordinary publishing activity, and the video’s core content remains an operational demonstration of Chrome being opened after troubleshooting.
